data.source: FRED series ICSA (Initial Claims, Seasonally Adjusted) weekly

behavior: Weekly jobless claims spike above the 4-week moving average by >15%, triggering panic, then reverse within 1-2 weeks as data normalizes or expectations reset.

market_impact.rationale: Consumer discretionary rallies on relief from labor shock fears; financial sector also benefits from recession-avoidance narrative.

trade_logic.entry: If ICSA > (4-week MA × 1.15) close above prior week close
trade_logic.exit: After 7 calendar days or when ICSA falls back below 1.10× 4-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Claims spike >15% above 4-week MA occurs 3–5 times per year; reversal within 7–14 days is typical seasonal/statistical noise.

idea: Freight Rail Car Utilization Snap-Down Rebound

data.source: FRED series RAILROADEQUIPMENT (Rail Equipment Utilization Index) weekly

behavior: Rail equipment utilization drops >8% week-over-week (demand shock), then snaps back as supply chain re-normalizes or demand catches up.

market_impact.rationale: Industrials and transportation stocks bounce hard on recovery in goods movement; signals economic activity resumption.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly rail utilization index drops >8% WoW and closes above prior week open
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or when utilization rebounds >5% from entry low

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Rail utilization is cyclical and volatile; 8%+ drops occur 2–4 times annually with quick reversions within 7–14 days.

idea: Mortgage Rate Spike Affordability Panic Fade

data.source: FRED series MORTGAGE30US (30-Year Fixed Mortgage Rate) daily

behavior: 30-year mortgage rates jump >25 bps in a single day (Fed move or risk-off shock), triggering panic in housing-sensitive sectors, then fade as sentiment stabilizes.

market_impact.rationale: Real estate panics on rate shock, then recovers as investors realize medium-term fundamentals intact; REITs snap back.

trade_logic.entry: If MORTGAGE30US rises >25 bps in one day, close above open
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or when mortgage rate falls back >10 bps from entry

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Daily mortgage rate moves >25 bps occur 6–10 times per year; reversions within 3–7 days are common.

idea: Hotel Occupancy Rate Weekly Collapse Snap

data.source: FRED series HOUST1MUSA (1-Family House Starts, or proxy via hospitality leading indicators) weekly

behavior: Hotel occupancy rate (measured via alternative weekly hospitality data or event calendars) drops >12% WoW on weather/event cancellation, then snaps back as bookings normalize.

market_impact.rationale: Travel/leisure crash, then bounce on realization shock is temporary; consumer discretionary recovers.

trade_logic.entry: If hotel occupancy proxy metric drops >12% WoW and closes above prior week midpoint
trade_logic.exit: After 7 trading days or when occupancy rebounds >6% from trough

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal hotel demand swings and weather events cause weekly volatility; 12%+ drops occur 3–5 times annually.

idea: Corporate Bond Yield Spread Inversion Compression Trade

data.source: FRED series BAMLH0A0HYM2 (ICE BofA High Yield OAS) weekly

behavior: High-yield OAS widens >40 bps in a single week (credit panic), then compresses as credit sentiment recovers and yield buyers step in.

market_impact.rationale: Credit widening panics financials and leverage-exposed cyclicals; recompression rallies both.

trade_logic.entry: If HY OAS widens >40 bps WoW, close above open
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or when HY OAS tightens >15 bps from entry

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Weekly HY OAS moves >40 bps occur 2–4 times per year; reversions within 5–10 days are typical risk-on behavior.

idea: ISM Manufacturing Weakness Print Bounce-Back Signal

data.source: FRED series MMNRNJ (ISM Manufacturing Index, monthly release)

behavior: ISM Manufacturing index drops >3 points month-over-month (contraction signal), triggering bearish reaction, then bounces as investors realize it's cyclical noise or data was front-loaded.

market_impact.rationale: Industrials and materials sell off on ISM miss, then rally hard on expected reversion within earnings cycle.

trade_logic.entry: Day after ISM release, if index drops >3 pts MoM and close > open
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or when XLI outperforms SPY by >1% over 2 days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: ISM swings >3 pts occur 4–6 times annually; post-release bounce-backs within 3–7 days are highly consistent.

idea: Google Trends Surge in 'Recession' Searches Capitulation Sell Signal

data.source: Google Trends weekly search volume for keyword 'recession' via google_trends adapter

behavior: Weekly search volume for 'recession' spikes >100% (fear capitulation), which historically marks sentiment bottoms before 1–3 week rally.

market_impact.rationale: Peak fear/recession angst often coincides with market bottoms; discretionary recovers fastest on sentiment relief.

trade_logic.entry: If 'recession' search volume > 2× prior 4-week average, close above open
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or when 'recession' volume falls back to <1.5× 4-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Recession search spikes occur 3–5 times per year during volatility; most reverse within 5–14 days.

idea: Crude Oil Volatility Index (OVX) Spike Compression Trade

data.source: Yahoo Finance daily prices for OVX (Crude Oil Volatility Index) via price_only adapter

behavior: OVX spikes >30% in a single day (supply shock panic or geopolitical spike), then compresses over 5–10 days as mean reversion and sentiment stabilizes.

market_impact.rationale: Energy volatility spike followed by mean reversion lifts crude and energy equities as panic fades.

trade_logic.entry: If OVX > (20-day MA × 1.30) and closes above open
trade_logic.exit: After 7 trading days or when OVX falls >10% from spike close

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: OVX >30% spikes occur monthly or bi-weekly; reversions are predictable and occur within 3–7 days.

idea: EV Charger Installation Acceleration Trend Momentum Shift

data.source: OpenChargeMap network growth (new charger installations per week) via openchargemap adapter

behavior: Weekly EV charger installation count jumps >25% WoW (grant round release, policy push, or regional buildout), signaling green tech demand inflection.

market_impact.rationale: EV charging buildout signals tech/infrastructure play; semiconductor and electronics demand benefits.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly new charger count > 1.25× prior 4-week MA, close above open
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or when charger growth rate normalizes back to <1.1× MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: EV charger installations are accelerating; 25%+ surges occur 2–3 times per quarter; momentum holds 7–14 days.

idea: Food Price Inflation (Grocery Basket) Google Trends Spike Rotation Signal

data.source: Google Trends weekly search volume for keywords 'grocery prices' or 'food inflation' via google_trends adapter

behavior: Weekly search volume for grocery/food price concerns spikes >80% (consumer pain point), triggering rotation from discretionary to staples and health.

market_impact.rationale: Food inflation anxiety signals consumer margin pressure; discretionary spending retrenches; staples and healthcare become defensive rotations.

trade_logic.entry: If 'grocery prices' search > 1.8× prior 4-week MA, short XLY, close above open
trade_logic.exit: After 8 trading days or when search volume falls back to <1.4× MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Food inflation concerns spike 2–4 times per year; rotations persist 5–10 days before mean reversion.
